stayType: Holiday park with caravans, lodges and apartments
accommodation: 291 units: graded caravans, Surf Village lodges with decking and private hot tubs, sea-view apartments and a farmhouse. No camping or touring. Open 20 March to 2 November 2026.
suitableFor: Families, groups, dog owners (some caravans), guests wanting on-site leisure and entertainment.
parking: Parking beside lodges; Surf Village units have private parking for two cars. EV charging in main car park plus lodge chargers.
dogs: Some caravans dog-friendly; dogs on leads in most outdoor areas, not in pools, spa or entertainment venues.
beachAccess: About 15 minutes' steep walk to Woolacombe beach (stiles, not pushchair friendly), or about 5 minutes by car.
confirmedFeatures: indoor and outdoor heated pools, waterslides, water sports lake, spa with thermal suite, gym, cinema, live entertainment, amusements, bars and restaurants, convenience store, EV charging
overview: The closest of the Woolacombe Holiday Parks group's sites to the village, set on the hillside above Woolacombe in North Devon. It offers graded caravans, hot-tub lodges in a quieter Surf Village area and sea-view apartments, with pools, a spa and evening entertainment. The beach is about a 15-minute walk.
surfTripFit: Walkable to Woolacombe's long beach break and with a Surf Village area, it suits surf families who want facilities, though the walk is steep and no board storage is stated.
gaps: Board/wetsuit storage not stated (group page mentions surfboard hire with some units).
